This is just a PSA post for anyone encountering the same issues with Borderlands 2 & the Pre-sequel not launching in Steam.

Adding the following as a launch option could resolve the issue (I know it works on Arch and Arch based derivatives, but don't know about other distros):

SSL_CERT_DIR="/etc/ssl/certs" LD_PRELOAD='./libcxxrt.so:/usr/$LIB/libstdc++.so.6' %command%

Took a lot more searching than it should have to find this solution, as many entries discuss adding the LD_PRELOAD, but not the SSL_CERT_DIR part, and one without the other did not resolve it for me.
